Ohh, is that right, mate...? No soul in machine stitching, eh...?
Right, I'll give you your bloody handmade! HANDMADE! BESPOKE! HAND-SEWN!!
New season... I'm stitchin' up whatever I fancy, whatever I can get my hands on. Just like the Voice said... never had to put up with all that shite quietly in the first place...

... Oi, hear that blubberin'? Sounds proper desperate, ain't it? And... a bit sweet, too...!
*snicker* I'm starvin'... Gonna get my teeth into that... chew it right up!

Looms... heh. Loopwheels. Sewing machines... heh, heheh... 43200G... No, no, bugger that! Shift the lot! It's "handmade" they're after, innit? "HANDMADE"... Khh... Why do they keep bangin' on about "handmade" when what they're actually after are bleedin' machines... EH?!

Look... if you know sod all about somethin', you keep your gob shut, don't you? But there's always some smart-arsed git, innit? Knows a fingernail's worth, reckons he's got the whole bleedin' hand sussed.
... And, oh, can't those buggers stop gabbin'... No! Gabbin' ain't even the problem! Why do they come out with nothin' but shite... and act like every bleedin' word's some big truth...?!

That's how they did it dozens of seasons back... Hang on. Them lot used to kick up a stink 'cause their clobber shrank in the wash. Had to be pre-shrunk, they said. Now they're after the stuff that ain't been treated? Can't they make up their mind?
Selvedge... and rigid denim... ain't the same thing...

I sewed it by hand, just like you bloody asked!! What?! The stitches are too even, so a machine must've done it?! Get back here, you c$#%! I'll show you 18 premium stitches! Shit-ten and bugger-eight, straight into your skin! WITH THIS NEEDLE!!!

"Proper leather's got to show its teacore, hasn't it?!" "Chrome-tanned and full aniline, 'course it is?!" "Wouldn't touch it if it ain't full-grain?!" Oh, now that I've converted to Le Rouge, bloody leather's fair game to b**** and m*** over too, that it...?!
Stitch per inch... stitch per inch... stitch per inch, stitch per inch, stitch per inch, stitch per inch, stitch per inch, stitch per inch, stitch per inch!
Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your bum!!!
What now?! Another mardy sod with a complaint?! Give it here!
Difficult customers in black... I KILL!
That racket's doin' my head in... What're you gonna start blatherin' about now?!
A spirited cry...!
You ain't even got a clue about what you're yappin'...
Ahh... You really mean it...?
Don't you give me lip about my work!
It's... the wrong way round...?! Now you're just... tryin' to piss me off, aren't you...
Not a single complaint? Pull the other one! It's got bells on!
H-heheheh! Oh, give over! Stop talkin' out your arse!!!
More... more...! That ain't... near enough...!! Those bastards... the whole bleedin' lot...!
Even? Neat as a pin! Stitched your traps right shut! Heh, heheheh...! Still reckon that's a machine job, you cheeky sods?!
One bite... If I could just get my teeth in... one bleedin' bite...!!! Again... again...!
